analysis: P12 empirically calibrated known-truth stress test

estimator_definitions.cell_equal_demean: observed user-category cell-equal user demeaning plus the known target grand mean
estimator_definitions.oracle_dm_hajek: oracle residualized Hájek control variate around the exact simulated conditional-outcome surface; not a fitted DR learner
estimator_definitions.oracle_hajek: self-normalized target/behavior importance weighting with known simulated propensities
estimator_definitions.row_weighted_demean: row-weighted user residual plus the known target grand mean
estimator_definitions.scalar_level_shift: naive centered shape plus the known target grand mean

interpretation_boundary: Synthetic failure-boundary evidence calibrated only to the paired KuaiRand random category shares; it does not estimate a real platform effect or validate an estimator universally.

mean_scale_additive_positive_control.definition: Bernoulli mean is exactly user-level plus category-level additive; serving selects the user level by category. This is a positive control for the demeaning assumption, not a realistic universal DGP.

oracle_anchor_warning: scalar_level_shift, cell_equal_demean, and row_weighted_demean borrow the known target grand mean. They isolate shape behavior and are not deployable without exploration data for that anchor.
oracle_warning: oracle_hajek uses the true simulated serving probabilities, which are unavailable in the released KuaiRand logs.
outcome: Bernoulli engagement with known user-video probabilities
replication_interval_definition: Each replication redraws the finite outcome/serving world and the realized logs. Reported 2.5--97.5 percentiles are across-world stress-test prediction intervals, not sampling confidence intervals for one fixed platform. MCSE describes the reported mean.

definition.description: User, affinity, and video selection act together with weak overlap.
definition.label: combined_weak_overlap

definition.description: Serving equals the target user and within-category video mixture.
definition.label: target_like

definition.description: Serving selects user-category affinities that also enter outcomes.
definition.label: user_category_interaction

definition.description: Category exposure selects on a user-level outcome term that is additive on the logit scale.
definition.label: user_composition

definition.description: Serving favors high-outcome videos within each category.
definition.label: within_category_item_mix

target: Equal synthetic users and uniform videos within category; category shares equal paired-random KuaiRand exposure shares.

weak_overlap_exposure_scale_sensitivity.purpose: precision diagnostic: true propensity weighting is identified in the simulation but unstable when effective overlap is small
